global_summary_cn: 宏观流动性宽松，全球风险偏好因美元走弱和美债收益率下降而得到支撑。然而，加密市场正经历剧烈抛售，主要驱动力是过去五天比特币现货ETF流出高达17.2亿美元。这造成了流动性与叙事之间的严重背离：尽管宏观环境利好，但资产价格却在暴跌。多数加密资产（如BTC、ETH、SOL）RSI均低于30，处于极度超卖状态，部分合约资金费率转负，显示空头拥挤。市场正处于由ETF抛售引发的恐慌阶段。我们判断当前是“买入恐慌”（Buy the Panic）而非“卖出反弹”（Sell the Rally）的设置，但需要等待ETF抛出的压力减弱，并关注是否有短时空头回补引发的反弹。
global_summary_en: Macro liquidity is loose, supported by a weaker DXY and falling US 10-year yields, which typically fuels global risk appetite. However, the crypto market is undergoing a severe sell-off, primarily driven by massive Bitcoin Spot ETF outflows ($1.72B over five days). This creates a critical divergence: macro tailwinds are present, but the crypto fundamental narrative is extremely bearish. Most major assets (BTC, ETH, SOL) are now deeply oversold (RSI below 30), and negative funding rates suggest crowded short positioning. The market is currently in a panic phase driven by distribution. We view this as a "Buy the Panic" setup, highly supported by the loose liquidity environment, but caution is warranted until the ETF selling pressure subsides. A sharp short squeeze bounce is highly probable given the current positioning.
